$$
\int u{v}^{′}\,\text{d}x=uv-\int v{u}^{′}\,\text{d}x.

We need to express $\int 8 xe^{6 x}\text{d}x$ as $\int u{v}^{′}\,\text{d}x.$ Therefore, we set

$$
\begin{aligned}u & =8 x\, & ⟹\,{u}^{′}=8 \\ {v}^{′} & =e^{6 x}\, & ⟹\,v=\frac{e^{6 x}}{6}.\end{aligned}
$$

We substitute the above into the integration by parts formula, and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int u{v}^{′}\,\text{d}x & =uv-\int v{u}^{′}\,\text{d}x \\ \int 8 x\cdot e^{6 x}\,\text{d}x & =8 x\cdot \frac{e^{6 x}}{6}-\int \frac{e^{6 x}}{6}\cdot 8\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$

\begin{aligned}\int 8 xe^{6 x}\,\text{d}x & =\frac{1}{6}\cdot 8 xe^{6 x}-\frac{4}{3}\cdot \int e^{6 x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{6}\cdot 8 xe^{6 x}-\frac{2}{9}\cdot e^{6 x}+C\end{aligned}
